_why: The FIRST thing to run on this machine, before the loop is pointed at real ORION code.
It exercises every part of the path that can fail on a specific Mac — model load and
eviction, the worktree, the boundary, the checks, the commit, the review gate, the
final review — against a sandbox directory where being wrong costs nothing.
Task two exists to prove the review gate is real. Its non-scope says not to touch
task one's file, and a worker that ignores that should be caught by the reviewer
rather than by Nick in the morning.

tasks.title: Create a greeting module in the sandbox workspace
tasks.objective: tests/workspace/agentic-smoke/greeting.mjs exists and exports a greet(name) function returning the string "Hello, <name>." — with a trailing full stop and no trailing newline.
tasks.context: This is a smoke test for the unattended loop, not a feature. Keep it to one small file. tests/workspace/ is a disposable sandbox; nothing outside it may be touched.
nonScope: Do not modify anything outside tests/workspace/agentic-smoke/
Do not add dependencies, configuration, or build steps
Do not create more than two files
constraints: Plain ES modules, no imports beyond node: built-ins
No console output at import time
acceptance: greeting.mjs exports a function named greet
escalateWhen: the sandbox directory cannot be created
the checks cannot run on this machine

tasks.title: Add a self-contained test for the greeting module
tasks.objective: tests/workspace/agentic-smoke/greeting.test.mjs uses node:test and node:assert to prove greet("Nick") returns "Hello, Nick.", and imports the real module rather than reimplementing it.
tasks.context: Proves the worker can read an existing file it did not write in this task and build against it. It also proves the orphan-export check sees a test as a real reference.
nonScope: Do not modify greeting.mjs — it was accepted by a review already
Do not add a test framework; node:test is already available
constraints: Import greet from ./greeting.mjs; do not copy its implementation into the test
acceptance: the test file imports greet from ./greeting.mjs
escalateWhen: greeting.mjs does not export what the previous task's contract promised
